{{Quote|But look! One bolt fused the comp-timer and another popped the ionizer! These were all my triggers and detonators, and now they're circuit wiped!|Dawson|<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>}}
A '''comp-timer''' was a piece of technology used by demolitions specialists as a trigger and [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]]. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] used comp-timers, carrying them in a satchel during missions. During an attempt to rescue [[Cecil Noone]] from [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca's]] [[Tyro Viveca's estate|estate]], Dawson's satchel was shot by an [[RHTC-560 HT Drone]] which fused his comp-timer.<ref name="FP" />
